Hi Eli —

Thanks for applying to the Platform Engineer role and for the quick response on your profile. I’d love to schedule a short 30-minute phone screen with our team to learn more about your background and share the role details.

I’m based in PDT (San Francisco) — below are a few windows that should land in your morning/early afternoon in Buenos Aires (ART, UTC-3). Please reply with any that work or propose 2 slots that are convenient for you: 

• Thu Sep 3 — 10:00 AM ART / 06:00 AM PDT
• Thu Sep 3 — 2:00 PM ART / 10:00 AM PDT
• Fri Sep 4 — 11:30 AM ART / 07:30 AM PDT

If none of those work, I can open a few evening slots PDT as well. I’ve attached a short PDF with what to expect on the call and the interviewers’ focus areas.

Also, if you can attach an updated resume (PDF is best) that helps the interviewers prep.

Best,
Ben Carter

Redwood Inference
